preConditions.onFailMessage: Hero classifications contain unsupported or duplicate normalized role/lane slugs. Resolve them before converting to enums.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM roles WHERE upper(btrim(slug)) NOT IN ('FIGHTER', 'ASSASSIN', 'MAGE', 'MARKSMAN', 'TANK', 'SUPPORT')
SELECT count(*) FROM lanes WHERE upper(btrim(slug)) NOT IN ('CLASH', 'JUNGLE', 'MID', 'FARM', 'ROAM')
SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT upper(btrim(slug)) FROM roles GROUP BY upper(btrim(slug)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_roles
SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT upper(btrim(slug)) FROM lanes GROUP BY upper(btrim(slug)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_lanes

changeSet.sql: UPDATE hero_roles relation SET role = upper(btrim(reference.slug)) FROM roles reference WHERE reference.id = relation.role_id
UPDATE hero_lanes relation SET lane = upper(btrim(reference.slug)) FROM lanes reference WHERE reference.id = relation.lane_id
